title: UTI and fall; home health planning fully documented, then a same-day addendum changes the disposition to SNF with no SNF choice process

rationale.disposition: The addendum, signed with the summary, changes the disposition to Lakeview Rehabilitation and Nursing (SNF); the patient-record hint agrees. The earlier 'Home with home health' line is superseded.
rationale.pac_list: The provider list documented in the CM note was of home health agencies for the superseded plan; no list of SNFs was presented for the actual SNF referral.
rationale.pac_choice: Freedom of choice and the patient's selection are documented only for the home health agency; nothing shows she chose Lakeview or was offered a choice of SNFs.
rationale.pac_quality_data: Care Compare ratings were reviewed for home health agencies only, not for SNFs.
rationale.info_transmitted: The summary was faxed to Brightwater Home Health, which is no longer the receiving provider; nothing shows it was sent to Lakeview or the PCP.
rationale.dp_discussed: The addendum states the change to SNF was discussed with the patient and her husband, who agree.
rationale.followup: The addendum has the SNF physician seeing her within 48 hours, and PCP within 2 weeks and neurology in 4 weeks are named.
